PHASE.NAME: Test Coverage Hardening
PHASE.GOAL: Raise workspace-wide test coverage from the current ~65% to ≥80% by adding 65+ targeted unit tests across the 4 most under-tested workspace crates (syn-skills, syn-run, syn-core, syn-mcp), while preserving all existing functionality and GRACE contract integrity.
PHASE.SOURCE_PLAN: Reasonix v2.6.8 analysis recommendation #5: test coverage is the weakest quality signal. syn-skills has only 3 tests for 16 GRACE workflow skills; syn-run autonomous runtime lacks edge-case coverage for phase gates, self-heal, and handoffs; syn-core tracking/config lack boundary-condition tests; syn-mcp has test isolation issues masking coverage gaps.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: syn-skills: Add 12 tests covering SkillEngine::execute for 16 skills (grace_verify, grace_review, grace_refresh, grace_status, grace_lint, grace_explainer, grace_cli, grace_setup_subagents, run_status, run_start, run_resume, run_replay, run_handoff, cascade_list, cascade_show, cascade_apply).

syn-run: Add 16 tests covering RunManager phase gates (PreCommitVerify, AdvancePhase, AwaitReview), self_heal edge cases (corrupted state, missing files, empty action queue), handoff serialization round-trips, and scenario step ordering.

syn-core: Add 16 tests covering Config::set_config_key/unset_config_key boundary values, Tracker::db_path_for with mocked paths, tracking context_pressure edge thresholds, and memory lesson lifecycle.

GRACE verification loop after each crate: syn refresh --fix → syn verify → fix drift → repeat until clean.
